fusions.name: Cornerstone Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a stone block that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tamping Fists
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. It costs 4% of your maximum health, and its damage rises 6% for each tenth of your health you have lost (max 30%).

fusions.name: Roughcast Grip
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hod-Carrier's Shoulders
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your armour rises by 5%, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold you attack 5% faster.
